The '''''Harvester''''' was an [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]] active under the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], commanded by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Ransley]]. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the ''Harvester'' intercepted [[Dezono Qua's starship|the]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] of [[Dezono Qua]] by the desert world of [[Prine]]. However, Qua's ship was being flown by wanted [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] fugitive [[Dass Jennir]], after having killed the vessel's former owner. When Jennir refused to stand by and be boarded and instead attempted to make for the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], Ransley gave the order for two [[Alpha-3 Nimbus-class V-wing starfighter/Legends|Alpha-3 ''Nimbus''-class V-wing starfighters]] to destroy Jennir's ship.
